values.title: Experience
values.text: Over thirty years in practice for Dr Liddi and over twenty-five for Dr Novi, across all the specialities of dentistry.

values.title: Listening
values.text: At the first visit the patient tells us about their concerns and together we try to meet their needs, whether it is an emergency or a planned visit.

values.title: Continuing education
values.text: Dr Liddi and Dr Novi attend courses and conferences to keep their knowledge up to date.

values.title: Technology
values.text: The oral scanner captures impressions digitally and, in 80% of cases, avoids the traditional impression with pastes, alginates and silicones.
